name: Java
description: Java is a strongly typed, object-oriented language used for Android apps, enterprise systems and university courses.

blocks.html:
Introduction to Java

What is Java?

Java is a powerful, object-oriented language used for Android apps, enterprise back-ends, banking systems and big universities' courses. It is strongly typed: every variable has a declared type, and the compiler catches many mistakes before the program runs.

  • JDK (Java Development Kit): tools to write and compile code.
  • JVM (Java Virtual Machine): runs the compiled code, so the same program works on Windows, Mac and Linux ("write once, run anywhere").
  • Source files end in .java; the compiler turns them into .class files (bytecode).

Hello, World

blocks.html:
• public class Main: every Java program lives inside a class. The file must be named after the public class (Main.java).
  • public static void main(String[] args) is the entry point: the JVM starts here.
  • System.out.println() prints a line. Every statement ends with a semicolon ;.
javac Main.java     # compile
java Main           # run

Variables & Data Types

Declaring Variables

In Java you write the type first, then the name. Once declared, a variable can only hold that type.

Grade A, student: true
39.98
100

blocks.html:
• final makes a constant that cannot change.
  • String starts with a capital S: it is a class, not a primitive.
  • Characters use single quotes ('A'), strings use double quotes.

Type Casting and Integer Division

Java converts a smaller type to a bigger one automatically (int to double). Going the other way needs an explicit cast. Dividing two ints gives an int.

Operators & Conditions

Operators

KindOperators

Important: use == to compare numbers, but .equals() to compare String contents.

if / else if / else

switch

Use switch when you compare one value with many fixed options. The modern arrow form (->) needs no break.
The ternary operator condition ? a : b is a short if/else for values.

Loops

for, while and do-while

blocks.html:
Enhanced for, break and continue

  • The enhanced for loop visits every item of an array or collection.
  • break exits the loop; continue skips to the next round.
Nested Loops
The inner loop runs completely for each round of the outer loop.

Arrays & Strings

Arrays

An array holds a fixed number of values of the same type. The size cannot change after creation, and indexes start at 0.

[65, 72, 88, 95]
[0, 0, 0]
Index 10 is outside the array

blocks.html:
• array.length (no parentheses) is the size.
  • Going outside the range throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
  • Arrays.sort(), Arrays.toString() come from java.util.Arrays.

Methods

Writing Methods

A method is a named block of code. Its header says who can call it, whether it belongs to the class (static), what it returns and what it takes.

public static int add(int a, int b) {
    return a + b;
}

• void means the method returns nothing.
  • Parameters are a copy of the values you pass: Java is pass-by-value.

Overloading

You can have several methods with the same name if their parameters differ. This is called overloading.

Pass by Value

Changing a primitive parameter inside a method does not change the caller's variable. (For arrays and objects the reference is copied, so changes to the contents are visible.)

Classes & Objects

Classes, Objects and Constructors

A class is a blueprint with fields (data) and methods (actions). new creates an object, and the constructor sets it up. this means the current object.

blocks.output:
Ayesha passed? true
Bilal passed? false

blocks.html:
Encapsulation

Make fields private and give controlled access through public getters and setters. This lets the class protect its own rules.

ModifierVisible from
privateOnly inside the class
(none)Same package
protectedSame package and subclasses
publicEverywhere

static Members

A static field or method belongs to the class, not to a single object. All objects share it.

Inheritance & Interfaces

Inheritance

A class can extend another to reuse its fields and methods. The child may override a method (mark it with @Override) and calls the parent's constructor with super(...). Java allows only one parent class.

blocks.output:
Rex says Woof
I am Rex

blocks.html:
Polymorphism and Abstract Classes

A parent variable can hold any child object, and Java runs the child's version of the method. An abstract class cannot be instantiated; it forces children to implement its abstract methods.

Interfaces

An interface is a contract: it lists methods a class promises to have. A class can implement many interfaces.

abstract classinterface
Can have fields and constructorsYesNo (only constants)
A class can useOne (extends)Many (implements)
Best forA shared base with some codeA capability (Comparable, Runnable)

Exceptions & Collections

Exceptions

Errors in Java are exceptions. Handle them with try, catch and finally. Checked exceptions (like IOException) must be handled or declared with throws; unchecked ones (like NullPointerException) need not.

ArrayList

An ArrayList is a resizable list. The type in angle brackets (<String>) says what it holds. Use wrapper types such as Integer for numbers.

HashMap

A HashMap stores key to value pairs with fast lookup.

• Import them first: import java.util.*;.
  • Declare with the interface type: List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();.
